name: com.foreverworks/app-stores
title: App Store and Google Play
description: Read and answer App Store and Google Play reviews, and see TestFlight feedback and crash logs.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: For the App Store: the App Store Connect API key's id (10 characters).

environmentVariables.name: ASC_ISSUER_ID
environmentVariables.description: For the App Store: the issuer id App Store Connect shows above your team keys.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: For the App Store: path of the .p8 key file App Store Connect let you download.

environmentVariables.name: PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: For Google Play: path of the service account's JSON key.

environmentVariables.name: PLAY_PACKAGES
environmentVariables.description: For Google Play: the package names to answer for, comma-separated, e.g. com.example.app.
